name: CaseGridChildTextHug
description: SEED contract for the CSS/DOM conformance fixture case "grid-child-text-hug" (grid-sizing). The fixture varies CSS CONSTRUCTS, not prop spaces, so the prop space is deliberately EMPTY: every axis the capture would enumerate is held at nothing, and the whole measurement is the computed truth of one mounted rendering. Construct: a TEXT child hugging its content inside a grid cell
